results.question: How many organizations does the knowledge graph contain?
results.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS organizations LIMIT 50

results.question: How many produces relationships are in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH ()-[:produces]->() RETURN count(*) AS produces_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct locations do the documents of cluster 2 mention?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 2})-[:mentions]->(l:Location) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS locations LIMIT 1

results.question: How many documents in cluster 11 mention at least one event?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 11})-[:mentions]->(e:Event) RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS document_count LIMIT 1

results.question: List the events mentioned in cluster 3.
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 3})-[:mentions]->(e:Event) RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS event_name LIMIT 50

results.question: In which clusters is the fbi mentioned?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'fbi' RETURN DISTINCT d.cluster_id
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(o:Organization {name: 'fbi'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.cluster_id AS cluster_id LIMIT 50

results.question: How many documents mention microsoft?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'microsoft' RETURN count(DISTINCT d)
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'microsoft' RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS documents

results.question: How many organizations are mentioned in more than three clusters?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(o:Organization) WITH o, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 3 RETURN count(o)
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(o:Organization)
WITH o, COUNT(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusterCount
WHERE clusterCount > 3
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT o) AS orgCount
LIMIT 50

results.question: Who is affiliated with nasa?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:affiliatedWith]->(o:Organization {name: 'nasa'}) RETURN p.name AS person_name LIMIT 50

results.question: How many people are affiliated with at least one organization?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:affiliatedWith]->(o:Organization) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS people LIMIT 50
